fight_technique_name: False Base Station Or Access Point
actions: Isolate the rogue cell via immediate RAN exclusion list update.
Enable strict NAS security mode (e.g., enforce NAS integrity protection).
Deploy NAS message validation rules for eEA0/eIA0 sizes (≤128 bits).
Trigger automated NAS re-authentication for affected devices.
Set NAS sequence number (seq_no) threshold (≤31) for anomaly alerts.
Block unrecognized NAS element IDs (e.g., elem_id=7, 18) via core firewall.
Enable 5G NAS replay attack detection with 3-second timestamp validation.
Configure NAS spare bits (≤8) and size limits for eMM messages.
Deploy RRC connection reset for devices with gsm_a_extension_size=1.
Monitor NAS message frequency spikes (>5/minute) as attack KPI.

mapped_mitigations.fgm_name: Discard RAN Signaling Received Without Integrity Protection
